verdicts.missing: The quote establishes the removal is in release 18 (18.0.0 section), but does not state that the upgrade being performed crosses release 18; that depends on the upgrade's version range, which the quotes do not give.

The quote only says the scheduler/tracing API was removed in React 18; it says nothing about whether any application uses that API. Per the guidance, a claim about an application is judged supported only when the quotes establish that apps meeting the condition are affected; here they establish the removal, which would affect apps using the API, but the claim's condition (application uses the API) is a hypothesis the quotes do not establish as affected-by-design. Treating it as the affected-app condition, the quote states the API was removed, so apps using it are impacted, which supports the claim's core.
